"Create a massive top-down 2D football game engine replicating the core features of FC 27, divided into interactive match gameplay, an open-world social hub, an advanced career mode backend, and a card collection museum. 

For the Gameplay 2.0 match engine, configure Physics Engine 2.0 and give the 'Striker' object a top-down movement behavior. Implement 'Off-Balance Dribbling' by checking if the Striker is moving over a speed threshold; if they collide with an opponent, let them maintain their movement vector unless the opponent triggers a manual tackle variable. Program an AI teammate named 'Winger' to constantly search for open layout coordinates away from defender objects; when the player passes, force the Winger to execute an automated curved running path into space behind the defensive line. Disable all automated AI defense tracking and ball-stealing logic; the 'EnemyDefender' object can only secure the ball if its bounding box overlaps the ball while a manually activated tracking state key is being held down. Replace standard automatic pass targeting by spawning a mouse-controlled target cursor when the 'Through Pass' key is pressed, forcing the ball object to apply an impulse directed exactly toward the cursor's coordinate. 

For the Open World Hub called 'The Grounds', build a large map scene divided into three distinct visual tile regions named 'Parkside', 'Montlair', and 'Zaza'. Place three stationary mentor NPC objects named 'Khloe', 'Kylian', and 'Paulo' into their respective districts; when the player enters their collision zones and presses the interaction key, open a dialogue UI box to launch localized skill mini-games. Place an interactive matchmaking zone in the map center that updates a global variable called 'LobbyPlayerCount' up to a maximum limit of 100 players to simulate a shared multiplayer environment. 

For the Career Mode backend, build a global data structure representing a player database where each player profile entry contains explicit numerical variables for 'BaseOVR', 'xTV_MarketValue', 'Form', 'Morale', and 'Fitness'. Write an event loop that dynamically calculates a player's functional rating before every match begins using the formula: ActiveOVR = BaseOVR + FormModifier + MoraleModifier - FitnessPenalty, and flag an injury risk state if the Fitness variable drops below a defined threshold. Build a multi-stage UI transfer negotiation layout that routes the user sequentially through an Inquiry pane revealing valuation, a Club Bidding panel featuring installment sliders and buy-back clause toggles, and a Player Contract panel with wage adjustments. 

For the Ultimate Team Gallery, create an interactive grid menu system that displays owned card items sorted dynamically into layout tabs for Nation, League, and Club. When a new card is added to the collection array, increment a 'GalleryExperience' variable; when this hits specific numeric milestones, increase the overall 'GalleryLevel' and trigger a visual reward popup. Finally, build a branching card evolution station UI where placing an eligible card item opens a split choice preview showing Alternative Upgrade Paths (Path A boosting speed metrics and adding a Role++ attribute, and Path B boosting passing metrics and adding PlayStyle perks), applying the chosen permanent stat modifiers to the card structure once the player confirms the choice.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
